scene.title: Weighted shortest-path frontier
scene.context: 2D (because the requested construction is planar): Create exactly one 20-second silent single-scene visualization showcase: Weighted shortest-path frontier. Animate Dijkstra on a nontrivial planar weighted graph with at least twelve vertices. Show the actual priority order, distance relaxation and recovered path between two nodes. Use 2D because this showcase specifically tests that representation. Prioritize a detailed, correct, recognizable construction and one meaningful operation, with a short final hold. Use the real animlib capabilities and available production tools. Do not replace the requested complex construction with a generic icon. Distinguish schematic/idealized geometry from measured data.
